- **Found:** 2026-09-19
- **Where:** `docs/bug-reports.md`

The ledger gates read the entry files and the index rendered from them. With no entry at all
`keelline bugs check` prints `nothing to check` and exits 0, so the row in the reusable
workflow would have been green over a ledger that did not exist — the shape this project
calls a gate that has never been observed to fail.

**Suggested fix:** carry one entry in the fixture, in a terminal state, so that every rule
the check holds an entry to is exercised by a real file.

## Fix

This entry is the fix: it is a closed record, it is rendered into the index, and the index is
compared against it on every run of the workflow.
